name: Leave Mr. Bear Alone
source:
Welcome to The Quiet Meadow! Sunshine, songbirds, and friendly faces – except maybe Mr. Bear. He’s not in the best mood. What will you do: brighten his day, or keep your distance?

[From [url=https://dueceladouce.itch.io/leave-mr-bear-alone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到安静的草地！阳光、鸣禽和友善的面孔——也许熊先生除外。他心情不太好。你会做什么：让他的日子变得美好，还是保持距离？

[来自[url=https://dueceladouce.itch.io/leave-mr-bear-alone]Itch.io[/url]]
